name: Byzantines 2TC 4:30
author: Acanthophis

notes: Once you got the 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ move to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ (or @resource/resource_stone.webp@ if it is closer)
2x @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ (in the video I move the vills at 2:15, so you can get your 2TC at 4:20)

get 3 from @resource/resource_food.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ 1 to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ keep @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_stone.webp@ to hit 4 then @resource/rally.webp@ on ::str. If you did @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ at 02:00 then @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@. You just need 4 on @resource/resource_stone.webp@. You keep 7 on food after @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ for 1-2 dropoff so that 3 on @resource/resource_food.webp@ can sustain @unit_worker/villager.webp@ production.

you take 1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ to build 1 @building_economy/house.webp@.  Once the house is done, you take him + 1 from @resource/resource_stone.webp@ so you build the @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ with 3 now. You only need 268 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ by the @age/age_2.webp@ because the @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ will give you 32. Keep @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ until @age/age_2.webp@

Congratulations! You reached @age/age_2.webp@ with 400 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and 300 @resource/resource_stone.webp@. Start building your second @building_economy/town-center.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ with the 10x @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from the @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@. I keep my @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@ and add the 3 from @resource/sheep.webp@ to them. The 3 on stone remain there to complere my @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@ Network as fast as possible. @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@ with main @building_economy/town-center.webp@. I like to have about 12-14 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ so I can go to @building_byzantines/mercenary-house-2.webp@ and other militray buildings right away, have wood for @building_byzantines/olive-grove-1.webp@ and @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ in case I want to defend @resource/resource_gold.webp@ / @resource/resource_stone.webp@. You don't even need to go out for another @resource/berrybush.webp@.

(In the video you will see that I misclicked and garrisoned 1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ at the last dropoff before the second @building_economy/town-center.webp@ placement, it is irrelevant to the timing of the @building_economy/town-center.webp@ placement as he was working before that on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@.)

description: This is a build order for a 2TC Byzantines build order, inspired by the 2TC OoTD 4:30 of Valdemar. I am a noob so you guys can make this cleaner than I did.
